source_reference: Challenge Docs/Project Listings/Georgia Power/2025 IRP Volume 3 PUBLIC DISCLOSURE.pdf

uncertainties: Document contains Critical Energy Infrastructure Information (CEII) and confidentiality notices; project costs and supporting statement are redacted.
The project title indicates endpoints at Evans Primary and Thurmond Dam (USA), but the description specifies that rebuild work is on the Euchee Creek to Thurmond Dam segment.
The specific project sponsor/owner is not explicitly designated on page 410, although GPC, GTC, MEAG, and DU are listed in the estimated cost breakdown.

evidence.text: Rebuild approximately 5.45 miles of Euchee Creek - Thurmond Dam segment of the Evans Primary - Thurmond Dam (USA) #5 115kV line with 200C 1351 ACSS Martin conductor. Replace the main bus with a larger element at Thurmond Dam (USA).
